items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH session_starts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id)
        session_id,
        device_type,
        timestamp AS session_start
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= (current_date - 7)::timestamp
      AND timestamp < current_date::timestamp
    ORDER BY session_id, timestamp
),
payment_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session_id
    FROM events
    WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
      AND timestamp >= (current_date - 7)::timestamp
      AND timestamp < current_date::timestamp
)
SELECT
    ss.device_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
    COUNT(ps.session_id) AS payment_sessions,
    ROUND(COUNT(ps.session_id)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM session_starts ss
LEFT JOIN payment_sessions ps ON ss.session_id = ps.session_id
GROUP BY ss.device_type
ORDER BY ss.device_type;
